records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The Company’s operating revenue increased by 30.5 percent in the second quarter of 2022 compared to the same period in 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase resulted primarily from increases in revenue per shipment, fuel surcharge revenue and tonnage.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The operating ratio (operating expenses divided by operating revenue) was 80.4 percent in the second quarter of 2022 compared to 85.5 percent in the second quarter of 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The improved operating ratio compared to prior year is due to the Company’s continued focus on pricing initiatives, cost control and operating efficiencies in addition to the impact of our fuel surcharge program.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Consolidated operating income was $146.0 million for the second quarter of 2022 compared to $82.9 million for the second quarter of 2021.
